original_value: This paper presents a space mission planning tool, which was developed for LEO (Low Earth Orbit) observation satellites. The tool is focused on a two-phase planning strategy with clustering preprocessing and mission planning, where an improved clustering algorithm is applied, and a hybrid algorithm that combines the genetic algorithm with the simulated annealing algorithm (GA–SA) is given and discussed. Experimental simulation studies demonstrate that the GA–SA algorithm with the improved clique partition algorithm based on the graph theory model exhibits higher fitness value and better optimization performance and reliability than the GA or SA algorithms alone.

result.paraphrase: This paper describes a space mission planning tool developed for LEO (Low Earth Orbit) observation satellites. It centers on a two-stage planning approach involving clustering preprocessing and mission planning, applying an improved clustering algorithm and discussing a hybrid genetic algorithm and simulated annealing method (GA–SA). Experimental simulations show that the GA–SA algorithm, using an improved clique partition algorithm based on a graph theory model, achieves higher fitness values and better optimization performance and reliability than GA or SA alone.
